title: One attribute and provenance mechanism: GeometryBundle slots, SurfaceMetric source maps and csg face provenance use the HalfEdgeMesh attribute layers
description:
Repo plan merge 3C.14. Four attribute mechanisms exist: GeometryBundle's Map<String,Object> slots (EdgeMarks, SurfaceSpline, RingCandidates, CornerUvField, carried by SlotCarry), EmbeddedMeshTopology's arrays (handled by the HalfEdgeMesh operators ticket), SurfaceMetric's sourceVertexId/sourceEdgeId/sourceFaceId maps, and csg's BooleanFaceProvenance / QuadTriangulation source faces. Move them onto the attribute layers so propagation is defined once. Slot names are part of DSL serialization: keep them.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. Slots, SurfaceMetric provenance and csg provenance are attribute layers; SlotCarry's special cases are gone.
2. DSL outputs, ring and quad-suite fingerprints identical; saved DSLs load unchanged.
3. Unit suite passes; launch entry and screenshot.

User rulings 2026-10-21 on the design gate:
- (B): provenance on the mesh, values on the bundle. Every op that builds a new mesh stamps int layers for the source vertex and source face of each element (plus the input, for join and boolean); the bundle keeps its named slots; one carry(inputs, output) re-indexes every per-element slot through those layers, replacing SlotCarry's join/mirror/weld cases, repair's copy and join_geometry's merge; csg's face-provenance arrays become face layers.
- Corner UVs map through their source face plus a vertex match; no new corner domain.
- Solidify, extrude, inset, delete and loop cut carry slots correctly; output changes in DSLs that read tags, UVs, marks, bones or handles after them are accepted as bug fixes, measured against the mesh-61-before baselines and listed per DSL.
- SurfaceMetric's source maps stay the triangulation's own index maps (out of scope).
- Whole-bundle values (material, curve, rings, splines, repair report, dungeon data) stay named bundle values.
- tag_geometry stops writing into an upstream cached tag array.
testing-plan:
1. Fingerprints before and after.
2. mvn test.
changes-made: Baselines (MESH-61 agent, before any code change, from an untouched snapshot of the worktree at master cb083f35, tmp/base): quad suite /home/acw/Code/Ixdar/tmp/quad-suite/mesh-61-before (signatures identical to mesh-62-after on all 14; screenshots now 1280x1280 at the 1.25 headless scale, so this dir is the screenshot baseline; the runner's stage regex no longer matches master's timing lines, hence 'pipeline-incomplete'). DSL fixtures sweep over all 50 DSLs (mesh fingerprint, ui-state mesh block incl. slot names and edge-mark fingerprints, screenshot hash): worktree tmp/m61-fixtures-base/fixtures.json, 45 fingerprinted, 4 'mesh not loaded' (fertility_quad_layout, groups/subdivided_cube, hand_v11_bridged, hand_v12_posed), crawfish/IMG_4117 launch timeout; scripts tmp/m61_fixtures.py, tmp/m61_compare.py. Unit suite 560/560. Stopped at a design gate, no code changed: MESH-61 design gate (agent stopped before any code change; baselines recorded).  What exists. HalfEdgeMesh layers (MESH-59) are anonymous int arrays owned by the mesh, on vertices/edges/faces only (no corner domain), propagated by the in-place operators. The data the ticket wants moved is not like that: - Per-element slots of other types: _uv (CornerUvField, double per corner, dense faceIndex*3), _tags (Map name->boolean[] per vertex), _bone_weight_<name> (float[] per vertex), _edge_marks (Map label->boolean[]/int[]/float[] per edge id), _bezier_handles_start/_end/_bezier_handle_weight (float per edge), _face_material (int per face), capture_attribute's user-named FloatField slots, csg's three _boolean_face_* IntFields. - Whole-bundle values that are not per-element: _material, _materials, _curve, _surface_splines, _rings, _ring_regions, _repair_report, dungeon half_extent/cell_type. - Bundles share one mesh and are immutable: tag_geometry, mark_edges, set_bone_weight, capture_attribute, assign_bezier_handles and checker_material add data without touching topology, and their input mesh is an upstream node's cached output. HalfEdgeMesh has no copy. - repair_mesh carries _uv, tags and bone weights onto an ArrayMesh when its output is unoriented; ArrayMesh has no layers. - Most topology-changing nodes rebuild a fresh mesh rather than calling the operators (join, mirror, weld, repair, boolean, extrude, inset, solidify, delete, loop cut, subdivide). Today solidify, delete, extrude, inset and loop cut pass every slot through withMesh unchanged, so tags/UVs/marks go stale on the new ids. SlotCarry special-cases only join, mirror and weld; repair has its own copy, and join_geometry merges tags and bone weights itself. - SurfaceMetric's sourceVertexId/sourceEdgeId/sourceFaceId index its intrinsic triangulation, which is dense arrays (h>>1 edges), not a HalfEdgeMesh, and runs inside the geodesic hot loops.  Question 1: where do per-element attributes live?  (A) On the mesh, literally: HalfEdgeMesh layers become named and typed (int/float/double/boolean), gain a corner domain, and the bundle's per-element slots become those layers, keyed by the existing slot names. Costs: a HalfEdgeMesh copy (copy-on-write) in every attribute-only node, so cached upstream meshes stay untouched; ArrayMesh needs the same layers or repair drops them; and every rebuilding node still has to say where its elements came from.  (B) Provenance on the mesh, values on the bundle (recommended). Every op that builds a new mesh stamps int provenance layers on it: source vertex, source face, and source operand for two-input ops (join, boolean), using the existing int layers. The bundle keeps its named slots (names unchanged for DSL serialization) with a declared domain, and SlotCarry collapses to one carry(inputs, output) that re-indexes every per-element slot through the output mesh's provenance layers. That replaces join/mirror/weld/weldCornerUv, repair's carryVertexSlots, join_geometry's own tag/bone merge and the stale withMesh pass-throughs. Attribute-only nodes still just add a slot. csg's faceOrigin/faceSourceOperand/faceSourceQuad become face layers on the boolean's HalfEdgeMesh (the _boolean_face_* slots are dropped or read from them; see 3).  (C) Like (B), but the per-element values also move into a mesh-owned layer table that the bundle references by name. That is (A)'s storage with (B)'s propagation, and it still needs the mesh copy.  Question 2: corners. _uv is per corner and dense (faceIndex*3, triangles only), and mirror reverses corners. Under (B) a corner follows (source face, corner index), so mirror stamps a corner-reversal flag, or a corner layer domain is added. Recommendation: a source-corner face-relative mapping computed from source face plus vertex match, with no new domain.  Question 3: behaviour change vs DoD 2. Once solidify/extrude/inset/delete/loop cut carry slots properly instead of passing stale arrays through, a DSL that reads tags, UVs or marks after them can change output. hand*.dsl, skull, voyage_skull, tool_quilt, coons_cube and crawfish_union use tags, marks, bones, booleans or handles. Accept such changes as bug fixes, measured and listed, or keep stale pass-through for now and convert only join/mirror/weld/repair/boolean in this ticket?  Question 4: SurfaceMetric. Its source maps index the intrinsic triangulation, not a mesh, so turning them into layers means rebuilding SurfaceMetric on a HalfEdgeMesh (geodesic hot path, perf risk) or leaving them as the triangulation's own index maps. Recommendation: leave them and drop them from this ticket's DoD.  Question 5: whole-bundle values (material, curve, rings, splines, repair report, dungeon data) are not per-element and stay as named bundle values. OK?

Implemented per the 2026-10-20 rulings (uncommitted, worktree mesh-61, synced onto master b6836cba).

PROVENANCE ON THE MESH. HalfEdgeMesh layers can now be named (vertexLayerName/faceLayerName, vertexLayer(name)/faceLayer(name), writeVertexLayer/writeFaceLayer), and recordSources(sourceVertex, sourceEdge, sourceFace) / recordOperands(vertexOperand, faceOperand) write the source_vertex, source_edge (the input edge a minted vertex lies on), source_face and source_operand layers. Every op that builds a new mesh records them: MeshVertexOffset (identity), MeshDeleteVertices, MeshDeleteEdges, MeshAppend.join (two operands), MeshMergeByDistance.weld (first member of each cluster), SolidifyMeshNode.solidify, both extrude paths, both inset paths (inner vertices take their corner as source), loop cut (cut vertices record their edge), mirror (the copy is a second operand of the same base), repair_mesh (vertex sources only, seen through its weld stage) and the boolean backend (face sources and operands, plus a _boolean_face_origin face layer).

ONE CARRY. SlotCarry is now one entry, carry(inputs, output). Per-vertex slots (tags, _bone_weight_*, capture_attribute FloatFields) follow each vertex's source. Edges follow the input edge between their corners' sources, or between their ends' sources, or the edge a minted end lies on; marks and directed bezier handles (start/end swapped when the direction flips) both use this. Corner UVs go through the source face plus a vertex match, falling back to the same corner where a weld moved the vertex. Per-face materials follow the source face, and inputs that disagree get a MaterialSet plus _face_material. Tags OR over the source corners, so a weld still ORs them. Whole-bundle slots are copied from the first input that has one. A slot the op set itself wins; a per-element slot without provenance for its domain is dropped.
Removed: SlotCarry.join/mirror/weld/weldCornerUv, MeshRepair.carryVertexSlots and its weld-stage slot rewrite, join_geometry's own tag and bone merge, extrude's preserveHandles, inset's preserveOuterHandles, mirror's rebuildMirroredHandles (mirror now only reflects the carried handles of its mirrored half), CoonsHandleBuilder.rebuildHandlesAfterWeld (and MIN_WELD_TOLERANCE), the three _boolean_face_* slots, and MeshBooleanResult's provenance arrays and MeshBooleanNode's material block. Solidify, extrude, inset, delete and loop cut no longer pass stale per-element slots through withMesh. SurfaceMetric and the whole-bundle slots are untouched (rulings 4 and 5).

BUG FIX. tag_geometry wrote into the upstream node's tag array when a tag of the same length already existed; it now always builds a fresh mask.

TESTS. New SlotCarryTest (5 tests): extrude tags and marks, loop-cut halves, mirror corner UVs and reflected handles, join+weld tag OR, tag_geometry immutability. 4 of them fail on a master snapshot (extrude and join+weld with ArrayIndexOutOfBounds, loop cut and tag_geometry on their assertions). MeshBooleanProvenanceTest and BooleanTextureTransferTest now read the face layers. Unit suite 574/574 after the sync (565/565 before it).

VERIFICATION, against baselines from an untouched master snapshot. Quad suite 14/14 MATCH vs tmp/quad-suite/mesh-61-before (signatures and screenshots; tmp/quad-suite/mesh-61-after). DSL fixtures sweep over all 50 DSLs (worktree tmp/m61-fixtures-base, -after, -synced): every mesh fingerprint, edge-mark fingerprint and count, shader mode and screenshot is identical. The only differences are slot names: crawfish_union, cube_boolean_textured and skull lose the three _boolean_face_* slot names (now mesh layers), and neck_armor's join output gains _curve and _instance_mesh (join_geometry now carries whole-bundle slots). No DSL changed output through the newly correct carrying (ruling 3). Found and fixed during verification: faces with a known operand but no traceable source face lost their material, which changed 392 pixels of crawfish_union; they take the operand's material again and the screenshot is identical.

BEHAVIOUR CHANGES (all outside the fixtures): repair_mesh's unoriented ArrayMesh output drops tags and bone weights (no layers to carry them on); a repair weld takes the first member's tags instead of OR; inset's inner ring edges now take the outer edges' bezier handles instead of zero; mesh_boolean output no longer keeps operand A's stale tags and bone weights.

Launch entry 'MESH-61: mesh-boolean'. Scripts: tmp/m61_fixtures.py, tmp/m61_compare.py.
review-summary: Every node that rebuilds a mesh now records each element's source as HalfEdgeMesh layers, and SlotCarry re-indexes all per-element GeometryBundle slots through them. Slots used to be passed through by hand, or left stale on a mesh whose ids had changed.
